review:
Shark & Spark Hold & Win follows Little Shark under the waves, with two bonus rounds: Sharks & Ladders, inspired by board games, and a Coin Respin hold-and-win.

Pink pearls carry additive multipliers (+1x up to +20x) and orange pearls carry multiplicative boosts (2x, 3x, 5x and 10x). In the main game, the '+' multipliers act as regular symbols and pay when eight or more appear in one spin. Little Shark reacts to events as they happen. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 205 spins.
